en:
Dammit...I don't understand!
What is going on here!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to keep my promise to Kaede.
I need to find the truth.

<CLT=cltMIND>What's happening to us...
Why we're forced to play this killing game...

<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway...I've still got some time today.
I can't stay still, not now...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
